behavior: hashes the installed Illustrator executable and CEP manifest/index/module before requesting bootstrap
requests a fresh AdobePy Illustrator CEP bootstrap nonce and host identity through broker 47391
reads the AdobePy token only from the local runtime token file and never embeds it in source control
runs as a bounded pre-launch transaction and exits after readiness or timeout
does not launch Illustrator.exe and does not remain as a watcher or daemon

autostart_hook.launch_contract: Start the bounded bootstrap process, wait two seconds, then launch Illustrator through the official .lnk using the existing Explorer shortcut-first path.

invariants: The GUI host is still launched only through the official Start Menu shortcut via Explorer.
Do not launch Illustrator.exe directly from the bootstrap code.
Do not commit or print the AdobePy token.
Do not weaken global signature or integrity policy.
The scoped Illustrator host verification exception remains adapter-local.
Do not replace the bounded bootstrap transaction with a long-running watcher.
